name: SimpleITK Segmentation
description: Medical image segmentation using SimpleITK. Automatic thresholding, region growing, watershed, and connected components for organ/tissue segmentation.

videos.title: CT/MRI Medical Image Processing with SimpleITK

theory.overview:
Segmentation partitions a medical image $I: \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$ into disjoint regions $\{R_1, R_2, \ldots, R_k\}$ such that $\bigcup_{i} R_i = \Omega$ and $R_i \cap R_j = \emptyset$ for $i \neq j$.

Each region corresponds to an anatomical structure (organ, bone, lesion). The segmentation can be expressed as a labeling function:
$$L(\mathbf{x}) = \arg\max_{c \in \{1, \ldots, k\}} P(c \mid I(\mathbf{x}))$$

SimpleITK provides methods ranging from global thresholding (Otsu) to topological segmentation (watershed), each suited to different imaging scenarios.

otsu_threshold.title: Otsu Automatic Thresholding
otsu_threshold.content:
**1. Between-Class Variance Maximization**
Otsu's method finds the optimal threshold $t^*$ that maximizes the between-class variance $\sigma_B^2(t)$ for a bimodal intensity histogram:
$$t^* = \arg\max_t \sigma_B^2(t) = \arg\max_t \, \omega_0(t) \omega_1(t) [\mu_0(t) - \mu_1(t)]^2$$
where $\omega_0, \omega_1$ are the class probabilities and $\mu_0, \mu_1$ are the class means for intensities below and above threshold $t$.

**2. Segmentation**
The binary output is:
$$L(\mathbf{x}) = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } I(\mathbf{x}) > t^* \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$

manual_threshold.title: Manual Binary Threshold
manual_threshold.content:
**1. Range Thresholding**
A simple but effective segmentation using user-specified intensity bounds $[l, u]$:
$$L(\mathbf{x}) = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } l \leq I(\mathbf{x}) \leq u \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$

**2. Hounsfield Units**
For CT images, intensities are calibrated in Hounsfield Units (HU):
- Air: $-1000$ HU
- Water: $0$ HU
- Soft tissue: $+40$ to $+80$ HU
- Bone: $+300$ to $+3000$ HU

This allows reproducible thresholds across scanners.

connected_components.title: Connected Component Labeling
connected_components.content:
**1. Labeling Algorithm**
After binary thresholding, connected component analysis assigns a unique label $l_i$ to each maximal connected region. Two voxels are connected if they share a face (6-connectivity) or edge (26-connectivity).

**2. Size Filtering**
Small components (noise) are removed by discarding regions with fewer than `min_size` voxels:
$$R_i' = \begin{cases} R_i & \text{if } |R_i| \geq n_{\min} \\ \emptyset & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$
where $|R_i|$ denotes the voxel count of region $R_i$.

watershed.title: Watershed Segmentation
watershed.content:
**1. Distance Transform**
From the cleaned binary mask $B$, the signed Euclidean distance map in mm (voxel spacing included) is negative inside the object:
$$D(\mathbf{x}) = -\min_{\mathbf{y} \in \partial B} \|\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{y}\|_2 \quad (\mathbf{x} \in B)$$

**2. Seeds**
Seeds are the connected regions deeper than `seed_radius` mm ($D < -r$) with at least `min_object_size` voxels.

**3. Watershed Algorithm**
$D$ is flooded from the seeds; dams are built where floods from different seeds meet. Labels are kept inside the mask only; a separate object with no seed of its own stays unlabelled.

**4. Pipeline**
1. Binary threshold: $B = \{\mathbf{x} : t \leq I(\mathbf{x}) \leq u\}$ ($u$: image maximum by default)
2. Opening and closing by reconstruction (radii in voxels)
3. Distance map in mm
4. Seeds deeper than $r$
5. Watershed from the seeds
6. Objects cut by the image border are removed

parameters.name: number_of_histogram_bins
parameters.description: Histogram bins for the Otsu criterion.

parameters.name: upper_threshold
parameters.description: Upper bound for binarization (default: the image maximum).

parameters.name: seed_radius
parameters.description: Seed depth in mm: seeds are the regions farther than this from the object surface.

parameters.name: min_object_size
parameters.description: Minimum seed size in voxels: seeds (regions deeper than seed_radius) smaller than this are discarded before flooding.

parameters.name: upper_threshold
parameters.description: Upper bound for initial binarization (default: the image maximum).

parameters.name: distance_inside_is_positive
parameters.description: Must be false (kept for compatibility): the seeds use the distance in mm, negative inside.

parameters.name: distance_squared
parameters.description: Must be false (kept for compatibility): seed_radius is compared with the true distance in mm.

parameters.name: mark_watershed_line
parameters.description: Draw watershed dam lines between basins.
